title: Ejecutar smoke representativo TTS en Chromium CI sin generar audio
mission: Build and run a bounded GitHub Actions Playwright/Chromium smoke for the already-published generic text-to-audio candidate. Verify the visible/UI contract and observe network behavior without clicking generate and without sending any POST/TTS generation. This is the CI execution route for the existing representative-browser evidence class, not a new browser product.
definition_of_done: GitHub Actions installs a pinned representative Chromium/Playwright runtime and opens the exact public TTS candidate URL.
Browser asserts candidate marker, textarea, six voice choices, 1800-character limit/counter, and generate-control enabled/disabled behavior without clicking Generate.
Network instrumentation proves page load, text edits and voice selection send zero POST generation requests.
Bounded machine-readable evidence and screenshots are uploaded as an artifact and referenced by a durable return.
No user/synthetic text is sent to TTS, no generation POST occurs, and no Current/Human Accepted/Served promotion is made.
